items.title: A fan yells Pattinson's own "beggars" meme at him in Venice
items.summary: Robert Pattinson was signing autographs for a crush of fans outside the Venice premiere of Primetime when someone shouted "Somebody get these beggars out of here!", his line as the suitor Antinous in Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey and one of the year's most-used movie memes. Pattinson looked up and broke into laughter. DiscussingFilm's repost of the clip got 181K likes and the original by @leadaal 57K, with people calling it the meme escaping the screen.
items.author: @DiscussingFilm
